channel.title: Through My Quiet Lens
channel.description: Essays, conversations and reflections on work, leadership, technology and everyday life.

item.title: The Editorial Page
item.description: How reading The Hindu with my grandfather taught me to look beyond what happened and ask what an argument was really trying to say.

item.title: Equality or Equity?
item.description: A ten-minute walk to school became a lesson in fairness, time and the wisdom that can come from the smallest voices.

item.title: The Value of Being Bored
item.description: Boredom once felt like empty time. Looking back, it may have been the space where curiosity, reading and reflection quietly took root.

item.title: Generative AI Optimises for the Statistical Average
item.description: Convenience removes the need to practise small habits. AI may be the next step in that quiet trade-off.

item.title: Beyond Networking: What 20+ Teams and 100+ People Taught Me
item.description: The most meaningful relationships rarely began with an introduction. They were built while solving problems and doing meaningful work together.

item.title: One Less Thing to Worry About
item.description: Customers may forget the presentation or the price. They remember whether your presence made a difficult moment easier.

item.title: Two Dogs After Forty Years
item.description: I spent most of my life without a dog. Percy and Pluto quietly changed what I notice about presence, patience and home.

item.title: Where I Stand
item.description: A quiet reflection on uncertainty, reinvention and what it means to begin again while standing between identities, countries and chapters.

item.title: I Wasn’t Sure I’d Last a Month
item.description: A story about arriving in Singapore with doubt, slowly finding belonging and discovering that surviving can itself be a form of strength.

item.title: Listening My Way Forward
item.description: How hosting conversations helped an introvert discover that listening can be not only a strength, but also a way of leading.

item.title: Authenticity Doesn’t Shout
item.description: A reflection on the quieter signals of authenticity and why being genuine is often felt long before it is announced.

item.title: Winners Do Things Differently
item.description: What repeated exposure to high-performing people revealed about discipline, preparation and the small choices behind visible success.

item.title: Developing a Taste for Diversity
item.description: A personal reflection on food, familiarity and how openness to difference is often built gradually through ordinary experiences.

item.title: A Trip Down Memory Lane
item.description: Looking back at the people, places and moments that quietly shape who we become, even when we do not recognise their influence at the time.

item.title: Second Chances and First Choices
item.description: A reflection on regret, agency and the difference between being given another opportunity and choosing differently when it arrives.

item.title: Growing Together
item.description: Parenting is not only about helping a child grow. It also requires parents to keep changing, listening and learning alongside them.

item.title: Let Go
item.description: A quiet meditation on control, uncertainty and the strength it sometimes takes to release what can no longer be carried.
